mutants.description: Known-id rewriting sorts SHORTEST-first instead of longest-first: a short id like `compass` gets rewritten inside a longer dotted id like `compass.heading`, corrupting references to dotted cell ids.
Formulas no longer strip a leading '=' prefix, so '= a + 1' fails to compile instead of evaluating.
When a dependency changes, dependents' per-context caches are NOT cleared: a call() after a set() can serve the stale cached value.

mutants.replace: // mutant: cache not cleared on set
mutants.description: set() no longer clears the target cell's own context cache.
cache_result() no longer writes the result into cell.value, so chained formulas reading a snapshot of a computed formula see a stale/null value.
The min() array helper computes a MAX instead of a min.
propagate() marks dependents Ready instead of Stale after a dependency change (lying status bit).
clamp() integer helper swaps its bounds: clamp(x, lo, hi) becomes clamp(x, hi, lo), panicking or mis-clamping whenever lo != hi.
register() no longer wires dependents: set() propagates to nothing, formulas never marked stale.
Known-id rewriting no longer skips string literals: a cell id mentioned inside a string literal gets rewritten into cells[...] access, corrupting string contents.
build_formula_snapshot() no longer pre-evaluates formula/program dependencies: chained formulas read a null/stale dep value.
call() serves cached results even when they carry an error, instead of re-evaluating.
